Figure 2: Behavior of the XG loss under different parameter settings. Subfigures (a) and (b) illustrate the effect of varying the bounded-control parameter η for fixed values of a = 1 and a = −1, respectively. Subfigures (c) and (d) illustrate the effect of varying positive and negative values of a, respectively, with η = 0.5. The parameter a controls the asymmetry of the loss, whereas η determines its saturation level for large prediction residuals.
